notes: homepage_products_rail and homepage_whats_new_rail currently render an IDENTICAL product list (both read featured.hero) due to a bug in src/routes/index.tsx — featured.new (the isNew-filtered slice) is computed but never used by the homepage. Preserved as-observed, not fixed, per Phase 2A scope.

featured.chocolates and featured.extras (src/lib/products.ts) are computed derived slices that are not rendered by any current homepage section — dead derived data, not modeled as homepage_sections membership here.

admin-store.ts's homepageSections config (ids: hero/categories/featured/divine/gifts/chocolates/extras/testimonials) is NOT read by src/routes/index.tsx at all — toggling it in /admin/content has zero storefront effect today. See docs/catalogue/catalogue-migration-plan.md.
